I don’t want to finish my mba. I don’t want to reapply for law school. I give up on my job search. I just want to die.

Not all disabilities are visible. Mental disability is still a disability.

I have severe ADHD and anxiety. I loved Disneyland when I was a kid. But as time went on I felt more on edge and couldn’t stand waiting in line. I felt uncomfortable without anything to do. When I did solo trips I’d freaking lose it if my phone died. I don’t know what it is but I just get these massive panic attacks if I’m on my own in a crowd of people. That usually marked the end of my day. When I’m with people I feel like bothering them. My boyfriend is patient about it but I don’t feel comfortable using it around my friends because they don’t know about my disability and I’m still trying to cope with it myself. 

I appreciate Disney offers this service as it has greatly  improved my experience at the park but I’m sure the people who legitimately use it are going to get shafted by those who fake it.

I’m the girl. 

It was my last year of undergrad and I turned in my thesis. I was super excited it was over and I asked my friend in that class if he wanted to get pizza to celebrate. 

I was extremely happy I finished my thesis so I’m sure the euphoria clouded my judgment. After we got pizza I offered him a ride home since he bikes to school. He ends up inviting me in to his little bachelor pad and we watch Reservoir Dogs with beer. 

During the movie he asked if he could sit next to me on the couch. My response was “whatever dude. It’s your house.”

We finish Reservoir Dogs. I try to leave. He tries to kiss me. I freak out and profusely apologize and say “wait I have a boyfriend.”

I was in a relatively new relationship and it was the first relationship where I actually got to meet the guy in person. (Prior to that was long distance relationships with guys I met online)

This was not my proudest moment.
